The explicit cast preserves COUNT's BIGINT type.","sql":"SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM pickup_datetime) AS hour, CAST(SUM(timestamp_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT tpep_pickup_datetime AS pickup_datetime, COUNT(*) AS timestamp_trips FROM trips GROUP BY tpep_pickup_datetime) AS timestamp_counts GROUP BY EXTRACT(hour FROM pickup_datetime)"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Preserves the original day-of-month predicate and uses window counts with DISTINCT, retaining duplicate contributions and NULL route keys.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Aggregates by route and extracted calendar day before applying the original predicate and combining counts. The cast preserves BIGINT results.","sql":"SELECT pickup, dropoff, CAST(SUM(day_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips FROM (SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_day, COUNT(*) AS day_trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID, EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS daily_counts WHERE pickup_day <= 7 GROUP BY pickup, dropoff"}]}
